page.layout: One printed page (right-hand side of the scan), one column of running text in a Latin and Hebrew lexicon entry, with the page number top left, the running head Hebrew "שח" top centre, and the gathering signature at the foot. The left side of the scan is binding shadow. The right edge of the text is cut off by the scan, so the ends of many lines are missing. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Incurvavit se adorandi vel honoris exunde Graci προσκυνεῖν[?], Latini interprerare exponunt. Tertia radicalis mutata inditum aliud ה. Ista mutatio & aliàs fit, Nomine נָאָה[?] à נָאָה . Sunt qui putanttertia radicalis, geminam incurvatione in& Animi, Latriam [scil.] & Dulciam quamHonoris exhibendi Verba sunt. Hoc Totius conem in terram significat, ex more Orient& mox in Nomine. Construitur cum הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה עַל־מִפְתַּן · לִפְנֵי · לְ · אֶל · עַל[?] Præter. vavit se in limine portæ, Ezech. 46.2. בEt incurvando te honorem exhibeas illis,Partic. anomalum, מִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם Incurvversus ipsi foli, Ezech.8. v.16. ex Prætericompositum. Nam, scribit Kimchi in Comlebat dicere, וְהֵמָּה מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים Et ipsi inat affectu commotus, fermonem illico inconvertit, volens dicere, הִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם curvatis vos? Futur. לוֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ[?] Et in1.Reg.22.54. Hinc per Apocopam fpeEt incurvavit se pronus in terram usque,pro וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ, ficut dicitur וַיַּעַשׂ pro וַיַּעֲשֶׂה .Et incurvavit se in terram, 2. Reg.4.37.וַיִּכְרְעָה וַיִּכְרָכוּ[?] Venite procumbamus,put, flectamus genua, Pfal.95.6. ubi triaconjuncta.
שַׁחְוָת fœm. Fovea, Fossa, quasi locus בְּשַׁחֲוָתוֹ In foveam suam, Prov.28.10.
שְׁחִית f. Idem: Plural. cum Aff. הֶם־שְׁחִיתָם ipsorum, Threm.4.20. Psalm.107.20. SicCaptivitas, à שָׁבִית .

page.notes: The right edge of the scan cuts off the end of most lines of the text, so the words beyond the edge are not on the scan and are not transcribed. Greek and Hebrew readings are the most doubtful: the Greek at the start of line 2 (προσκυνεῖν) and the Hebrew in the lines with נָאָה, לְ · אֶל · עַל, וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ, וַיִּכְרְעָה and שָׁבִית are read from a small, partly cut image and are marked [?]. The word printed "Confiruitur" has the long s from the st ligature and is given as "Construitur" with the s normalised; the spelling "Confiruitur" is kept as far as the printed letters show. The first entry is treated as the start of a paragraph, since the page does not show whether the text continues from the previous page.
